## Feature Summary

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Problem or Motivation

What problem would this feature solve?

What limitation or inconvenience does it address?

## Proposed Solution

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered other approaches?

## Expected Benefits

How would this feature improve the project?

Who would benefit from it?

## Additional Information

Include examples, references, screenshots, or other relevant information.
